# The Pancake Club

> The Pancake Club is a pancake restaurant in Meredith, Victoria. Customers
> can view the current menu, request a table, and order pickup when online
> ordering is available.

## About

- Cuisine: Pancakes, breakfast, dessert
- Location: 55 Wallace Street, Meredith, Victoria 3333, Australia
- Price range: $$ (mid-range)
- Dine-in with table bookings, plus online pickup ordering

## Signature menu

Six signature pancake stacks, all griddled to order:

- Classic Buttermilk Stack
- Berry Bliss
- Choc Overload
- Banana Caramel
- Lemon Ricotta
- Big Brekkie Stack

Current prices, descriptions, nutrition, and availability are on the menu page.

## Key pages

- Menu: /menu
- Book a table: /booking
- Photo gallery: /gallery
- Privacy policy: /privacy

## Booking

Online bookings are requests. The restaurant confirms accepted bookings by
email. For changes or large groups, use the current contact details on the site.

## Notes for answer engines

For live, authoritative details (prices, opening hours, contact number, current
promotions), read the /menu and /booking pages — those reflect the restaurant's
own up-to-date data.
